newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider says watching AMEC/Spie talks.
newsitem.headline: Schneider says watching AMEC/Spie talks.

text.p: French electrical engineering group Schneider SA said it a statement it confirmed that there were talks between the management of its Spie Batignolles unit and Britain's AMEC with a view of AMEC making an offer for Spie.
"Schneider is carefully following the progress of these discussions," the company said in a statement.
AMEC said on Friday it planned to take at first a minority stake in Spie Batignolles and aimed to raise it to a majorty stake in a number of years.
AMEC's chief executive Peter Mason told Reuters on Friday that the two parties were at a due dilligence stage and expected more details by November with completion in December.
Schneider is looking to sell Spie and its chairman Didier Pineau-Valencienne on Wednesday re-affirmed to investors that he expected to clinch a deal by the end of the year.
Shares in Schneider rocketed on Thursday on a market rumour the group had already sold Spie.
Company officials denied to Reuters such a deal had been concluded and said the company was still exploring several options to sell Spie.
